sample_unit: AI responses (20 questions x 4 models) rated by 10 experts

links.outcome: Expert Likert ratings of consumer LLM responses to juvenile lupus questions
links.effect: DeepSeek median 5 (1-5), Gemini 4 (2-5), ChatGPT 4 (3-5), Copilot 4 (3-5); models differed significantly (Friedman χ2(3)=63.553, p<0.001; Kendall W=0.106).
links.quote: Overall expert-rated performance differed significantly among models [Friedman χ2(3) = 63.553, p < 0.001; Kendall W = 0.106].

screen.reason: The study evaluates and compares the performance and clinical relevance of four LLMs in answering juvenile SLE questions through expert ratings, without testing specific deployment practices or safeguards.
